what: Two background subagents stopped producing results in the middle of a Bash call (a heredoc that writes a script, and a setsid/& server start); the command never ran and no timeout fired, so the agents sat idle until stopped and resumed by hand.
tell: Subagent transcript mtime idle for more than 10 minutes with a tool_use as the last entry, no process and no output file from that command.
proposed_change: Brief subagents to write files with the Write tool and to avoid detached host processes; check transcript mtimes instead of waiting for notifications.
